title: Assignment 08 · Irrevocability and formation under Article 2
summary: Irrevocability and formation under Article 2. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Drennan v. Star Paving Co.: Reasonable reliance on a subcontractor’s bid protected the general contractor’s opportunity to accept it after winning the main contract, even though using the bid was not itself acceptance.

Dorton v. Collins & Aikman Corp.: A form stating that acceptance was “subject to” its terms did not clearly make the transaction depend on the buyer’s assent to those terms. Whether its added arbitration clause entered the contracts required further findings.

C. Itoh & Co. (America) Inc. v. Jordan International Co.: An expressly conditional acknowledgment prevented formation through the writings; subsequent performance formed a contract whose terms excluded the unmatched arbitration clause.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement §§ 45, 90; UCC §§ 2-204–2-207; N.Y. General Obligations Law § 5-1109.
